entries.verified: CTO-22 Gemini §4, read 2026-11-07: read_file, glob, grep_search, list_directory run without asking; read-file.ts resolves every path with resolveActiveWorkspaceDir and returns PATH_NOT_IN_WORKSPACE, so reads are confined to the workspace.
CTO-22 Gemini §4, read 2026-11-07: write_file and replace ask by default (policy write.toml); general.defaultApprovalMode auto_edit flips them to no-asking.
CTO-22 Gemini §4, read 2026-11-07: run_shell_command asks by default (policy write.toml); tools.allowed with run_shell_command (no prefix) approves any command.
CTO-22 Gemini §4, read 2026-11-07: web_fetch asks by default.

CTO-22 Gemini §4, read 2026-11-07: google_web_search runs without asking by default. BV-198 M3 (firma 2): a web tool allowed by default is internet egress — the query can carry the content of a request off the computer.
CTO-22 Gemini §4, read 2026-11-07: MCP tool calls ask by default; mcpServers.<n>.trust=true approves that server without asking.
CTO-22 Gemini §4, read 2026-11-07: general.defaultApprovalMode defaults to the asking mode; yolo in the file is ignored (config.ts:710-715), auto_edit stops asking for edits.
